# 8.css consolidated reference

8.css is a CSS-only library inspired by Windows 8 Start Screen / Modern UI and desktop. It uses semantic HTML and has no required JavaScript runtime. It is an independent community project, not official Microsoft software. Icons come from Font Awesome 4.7.0 by Dave Gandy, bundled unmodified and served from the package instead of a third-party CDN.

## Source of truth
- Edit component modules in `gui/`.
- Edit icon usage in page markup; the icon assets themselves live in `vendor/font-awesome/` and are not modified.
- Run `npm run build` to regenerate `src/8.css`, `dist/8.css`, `dist/gui/*.css`, `dist/font-awesome/`, `docs/8.css`, `docs/font-awesome/`, and `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`.
- Do not hand-edit generated CSS or font copies.
- Keep README.md, docs/index.html, docs/components.md, AGENTS.md, llms.txt, and this file synchronized.
- Runtime must remain CSS-only; icons are a static webfont.

## CSS module order
base.css, tiles.css, live-tiles.css, buttons.css, forms.css, navigation.css, feedback.css, window.css, taskbar.css, app-bar.css, charms.css, flyout.css, toast.css, lock-screen.css, hub.css, split-view.css, dialog.css, icons.css, responsive.css. The complete `dist/8.css` bundle prepends the Font Awesome 4.7.0 stylesheet to these modules and patches its font URLs to `./font-awesome/fonts/`. For modular use, load `dist/font-awesome/css/font-awesome.min.css` first, then `dist/gui/base.css`, then the required modules. Load `dist/gui/icons.css` for the 8.css icon helpers.

## Package usage
Install from npm using `npm install @flessan/8.css`, then import `@flessan/8.css`. For plain HTML, use `https://unpkg.com/@flessan/8.css@0.2.0/dist/8.css`.

```html
<i class="fa fa-envelope" aria-hidden="true"></i>

<button class="w8-button w8-button--primary" type="button">
  <i class="fa fa-check" aria-hidden="true"></i>
  Save changes
</button>

<button class="w8-icon-button" type="button" aria-label="Search">
  <i class="fa fa-search w8-icon--large" aria-hidden="true"></i>
  <span class="w8-icon-button__label">Search</span>
</button>
```

Icon-only controls must have accessible names. Use `aria-hidden="true"` on decorative glyphs. Icon color follows `currentColor`.

## Icon system
- Font Awesome 4.7.0, complete 675-icon set.
- Classes: `fa` plus a glyph class such as `fa-home`, `fa-envelope`, `fa-cog`, `fa-search`, `fa-share-alt`, `fa-user`, `fa-calendar`, `fa-file-photo-o`, `fa-windows`, `fa-sun-o`, `fa-check`, `fa-times`, `fa-chevron-left`, `fa-chevron-right`.
- Font Awesome utilities available unchanged: `fa-lg`, `fa-2x` to `fa-5x`, `fa-fw`, `fa-ul`, `fa-li`, `fa-border`, `fa-stack`, `fa-inverse`, `fa-spin`, `fa-pulse`, `fa-rotate-90/180/270`, `fa-flip-horizontal`, `fa-flip-vertical`, `fa-pull-left`, `fa-pull-right`.
- 8.css size hooks: `w8-icon--small` (1rem), `w8-icon--large` (2rem), `w8-icon--xl` (3rem). They work with `.fa` or the `.w8-icon` alias.
- `w8-icon` is an alias for the `fa` base class; it never changes the glyph mapping.
- Window controls use `fa-window-minimize`, `fa-window-maximize`, `fa-window-close`.
- Distribution: `dist/font-awesome/css/font-awesome.css`, `dist/font-awesome/css/font-awesome.min.css`, and `dist/font-awesome/fonts/fontawesome-webfont.{eot,svg,ttf,woff,woff2}`. License: `dist/font-awesome/LICENSE.txt` (also published as `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`).
- Removed: the earlier bespoke SVG sprite (`icons.svg`) and its `w8-icon-{name}` symbol IDs are no longer shipped.

## Public API
Start Screen: `.w8-start-screen`, `.w8-start-heading`, `.w8-start-subtitle`, `.w8-tiles`.
Tile selection: `.w8-tile--selected`, `.w8-tile__check`, `.w8-tiles--selecting`.
Tiles: `.w8-tile`, `.w8-tile__symbol`, `.w8-tile__label`, `.w8-tile__meta`, `.w8-tile__count`; size modifiers `.w8-tile--wide`, `.w8-tile--tall`, `.w8-tile--large`; colors `.w8-tile--blue`, `.w8-tile--cyan`, `.w8-tile--purple`, `.w8-tile--magenta`, `.w8-tile--green`, `.w8-tile--orange`, `.w8-tile--red`, `.w8-tile--dark`.
Buttons: `.w8-button`, `.w8-button--primary`, `.w8-button--subtle`.
Fields: `.w8-input`, `.w8-select`, `.w8-textarea`, `.w8-field`, `.w8-label`, `.w8-help`.
Choices: `.w8-check`, `.w8-radio`, `.w8-choice`, `.w8-toggle`, `.w8-toggle__input`.
Extra controls: `.w8-slider`, `.w8-slider__value`, `.w8-rating`, `.w8-rating__input`, `.w8-rating__star`, `.w8-search`, `.w8-search__input`, `.w8-search__icon`, `.w8-search--dark`.
Navigation and lists: `.w8-back`, `.w8-nav-bar`, `.w8-nav-bar__item`, `.w8-nav-bar__title`, `.w8-nav-bar--dark`, `.w8-list-view`, `.w8-list-view__item`, `.w8-list-view__icon`, `.w8-list-view__title`, `.w8-list-view__meta`, `.w8-list-view__trailing`, `.w8-list-view--dark`, `.w8-flip-view`, `.w8-flip-view__frame`, `.w8-flip-view__slide`, `.w8-flip-view__title`, `.w8-flip-view__meta`, `.w8-flip-view__text`, `.w8-flip-view__nav`, `.w8-flip-view__button`, `.w8-flip-view__count`.
Feedback: `.w8-progress`, `.w8-badge`, `.w8-notice` variants, `.w8-divider`.
Tabs: `.w8-tabs`, `.w8-tab`.
Desktop: `.w8-window`, `.w8-title-bar`, `.w8-title-bar__text`, `.w8-title-bar__controls`, `.w8-window-control`, `.w8-window-control--close`, `.w8-window-body`, `.w8-window-footer`.
App bar, Charms bar and dialogs: `.w8-app-bar`, `.w8-app-bar__item`, `.w8-charms`, `.w8-charm`, `.w8-charm__icon`, `.w8-charm__label`, `.w8-charm-pane`, `.w8-charm-pane__title`, `.w8-charm-pane__group`, `.w8-charm-pane__item`, `.w8-dialog`, `.w8-dialog__body`, `.w8-dialog__footer`.
Lock screen: `.w8-lock`, `.w8-lock__time`, `.w8-lock__date`, `.w8-lock__detail`, `.w8-lock__detail-text`, `.w8-lock__badges`, `.w8-lock__badge`, `.w8-lock__badge-count`, `.w8-lock__status`, `.w8-lock__status-item`, `.w8-lock__hint`, `.w8-lock__panel`, `.w8-lock__avatar`, `.w8-lock__user`, `.w8-lock__tools`, `.w8-lock__tool`, `.w8-lock--dimmed`, `.w8-battery`, `.w8-battery__level`.
Live tiles: `.w8-tile__badge` (`.w8-tile__badge--solid`, `.w8-tile__badge--alert`), `.w8-tile--live`, `.w8-tile__flipper`, `.w8-tile__face`, `.w8-tile__face--back`, `.w8-tile-groups`, `.w8-tile-group`, `.w8-tile-group__label`, `.w8-tile-groups--overview`.
Taskbar: `.w8-taskbar`, `.w8-taskbar__start`, `.w8-taskbar__apps`, `.w8-taskbar__app`, `.w8-taskbar__item`, `.w8-taskbar__preview`, `.w8-taskbar__preview-title`, `.w8-taskbar__preview-shot`, `.w8-taskbar__tray`, `.w8-taskbar__tray-item`, `.w8-taskbar__clock`, `.w8-taskbar__spacer`, `.w8-taskbar__show-desktop`, `.w8-taskbar--fixed`.
Flyouts and toasts: `.w8-flyout` with `--top`, `--bottom`, `--left`, `--right`, `--menu`, `--dark`; `.w8-flyout__arrow`, `.w8-flyout__title`, `.w8-flyout__text`, `.w8-flyout__actions`, `.w8-flyout__item`, `.w8-flyout__separator`, `.w8-tooltip`; `.w8-toast-region`, `.w8-toast`, `.w8-toast__icon`, `.w8-toast__title`, `.w8-toast__body`, `.w8-toast__close`, `.w8-toast__actions`, `.w8-toast__action`, `.w8-toast--peek`.
Hub and split view: `.w8-hub`, `.w8-hub__header`, `.w8-hub__title`, `.w8-hub__lead`, `.w8-hub__section`, `.w8-hub__section-title`, `.w8-hub__list`, `.w8-hub__item`, `.w8-hub__item-icon`, `.w8-hub__item-text`, `.w8-hub__item-title`, `.w8-hub__item-meta`, `.w8-hub__card`, `.w8-hub--dark`; `.w8-split`, `.w8-split__pane`, `.w8-split__main`, `.w8-split__title`, `.w8-split--snap-right`, `.w8-split--divider`.
Progress ring and app bar: `.w8-progress-ring`, `.w8-progress-ring--small`, `.w8-app-bar--top`, `.w8-app-bar--contextual`, `.w8-app-bar--circular`, `.w8-app-bar__separator`.
Icons: `.fa`, `.fa-{name}`, `.w8-icon`, `.w8-icon--small`, `.w8-icon--large`, `.w8-icon--xl`, `.w8-icon-button`, `.w8-icon-button--accent`, `.w8-icon-button__label`, `.w8-sr-only`.

## Wallpapers
`styles/images/` holds the Windows 8 (19) and Windows 8.1 (9) RTM wallpapers used by the demo. The Start Screen accepts artwork through custom properties:

```html
<section class="w8-start-screen" style="--w8-start-image:url('styles/images/Windows8RTM/img3.jpg');--w8-start-background:#4d96b0;--w8-accent:#0078d7">
```

Optional generated classes: `.w8-wallpaper-<id>` sets `--w8-start-image`, `--w8-start-background` and `--w8-accent`; `.w8-wallpaper-cover` applies them as a cover background to any element. `styles/images/wallpapers/manifest.json` lists every wallpaper with id, title, window, file, dimensions, byte size, aspect ratio, monitor span, dominant and accent colour. `dist/wallpapers/` republishes 480x300 thumbnails with root-relative URLs for consumers. Artwork is Microsoft copyright, demonstration use only, excluded from the full resolution npm files.

## Custom properties
`--w8-font-family`, `--w8-text`, `--w8-muted`, `--w8-surface`, `--w8-surface-subtle`, `--w8-border`, `--w8-accent`, `--w8-accent-hover`, `--w8-focus`, `--w8-tile-blue`, `--w8-tile-cyan`, `--w8-tile-purple`, `--w8-tile-magenta`, `--w8-tile-green`, `--w8-tile-orange`, `--w8-tile-red`, `--w8-tile-dark`, plus `--w8-start-background` and `--w8-tile-color` for the Start Screen canvas and individual tiles, and `--w8-start-image` for optional wallpaper artwork.

## Accessibility boundary
Use semantic controls and accessible names. Hide decorative icons with `aria-hidden="true"` and label icon-only controls. Keep focus visible, check contrast with custom colors, and respect reduced-motion settings. CSS styles controls but does not manage state, tab keyboard navigation, window controls, announcements, or focus management.

## Validation
Run `npm run build`, `npm test`, `npm run build:site`, and optionally `npm run test:browser` (needs a local Chromium; verifies rendered icons, console/network errors, horizontal overflow at 1280px and 390px, mobile menu, code copy, code snippets, skip link and reduced-motion). Checks validate module/bundle parity, CSS brace structure, font and license asset parity between `vendor/`, `dist/`, and `docs/`, glyph coverage in the shipped font for every icon class used by the HTML pages, accessible icon markup, package `files`/`exports` integrity, and documentation consistency.
